api.privacy: In Lively and Rowdy modes, every window switch sends the text visible in that window (up to about 60 lines; input fields, emails, phone numbers and URLs removed) to this service.
app.name: LifeNarrator
blacklist.hint: One bundle ID per line. Excluded apps will not be read.
liveliness.hint: The sprite reads the text in each window and boxes what is worth a remark. Quiet responds only to rules.
liveliness.lively.hint: Reads the screen, remarks on a few spots
liveliness.quiet.hint: Speaks only when your rules hit
onboarding.done: Find me in the system tray at the right end of the taskbar (click ^ if you do not see me). Right-click my icon to pause or open Settings; opening LifeNarrator again also shows Settings.
onboarding.title: Hi there, I'm your little narrator
pace.hint: Liveliness decides how much; this decides how fast.
pace.dwell.hint: With more than 3 marks on screen, each stays at least %g seconds so they can appear together.
pace.maxOnScreen.hint: An upper limit: how many appear depends on what can be remarked on and the free space around it. Switching windows clears them.
provider.none.hint: Keyword rules and offline lines still work.
settings.title: Settings
windows.privacy: Screen text is never logged or saved. Input fields, emails, phone numbers and URLs are removed before the model sees them. Connecting a cloud API sends visible text to that service.
windows.reading: LifeNarrator reads the active window title and visible text to match your rules, never password fields. Windows uses UI Automation to read text.
memory.title: Local memories
memory.privacy: Stored only on this computer; original screen text is never saved.
memory.clear.hint: This permanently deletes every memory. Your rules will be kept.
memory.empty: No memories in this category yet.
memory.duplicate: Your sprite already remembers something similar.
memory.rule.hint: Open the Rules tab to edit this preference.
growth.title: Growing together
growth.name: Sprite name
chat.subtitle: A little company
chat.empty: What’s on your mind? I’m here.
chat.privacy: Chat, memories and context go to your selected service. Attached screen text filters input fields, emails, phone numbers and URLs.
chat.title: Chat with your sprite
updates.title: Updates
updates.installFailed: Update installation failed; view installation log
model.windows.hint: Fast is recommended on Windows. Standard is slower without a dedicated GPU. The selected model activates when its download is ready.
api.vision.hint: Requires a vision model such as deepseek-flash, GPT, Claude or Gemini. Narrations and chats with screen attached send the current window image to this provider, after masking email, phone numbers, URLs and input fields. Requires Screen Recording permission.
input.title: Tell me something
input.placeholder: I hate Google. Alice is my boss…
input.hint: Press Return and I'll make it a rule.
dwell.persistent: Stay until clicked or the window changes
systemOne.enable: Use an external System One service
api.keyRejected: The model service rejected the API key. Check that the key is correct and saved (look for "Key saved").
api.invalidURL: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL.
onboarding.accessibility.hint: LifeNarrator reads the active window title and visible text to match your rules. Password fields are never read. Allow access in System Settings; you can continue without it and grant it later.
onboarding.screen.hint: Some apps do not expose readable text. Screen Recording lets LifeNarrator recognize text in the active window. Without it, Accessibility-based narration still works.
pace.gap.hint: At least this long between two remarks
persona.hint: The persona also picks the bubble font.
preview.hint: Changes pop up here right away.
rules.empty.title: No rules yet
rules.empty.body: Tell me something like "I hate meetings" or "Alice is my boss". I'll remember, and speak up when it shows.
rules.builtin.hint: Used only without a model. With one, the sprite reads the screen and speaks for itself.
screenRecording.title: Turn on Screen Recording for sharper frames
screenRecording.body: Chat apps and terminals don't report where their text is. With Screen Recording on, the sprite takes a quick look at the window to find it (processed on your Mac, never saved).
persona.custom.hint: Create a persona from one sentence
persona.custom.placeholder: For example: a programmer who talks like a big brother
persona.custom.noModel: Choose a model in Models first.
persona.custom.downloadModel: Download the built-in model or configure an API model first.
persona.custom.configureModel: Enter a valid API URL and model name in Models first.
screenRecording.repair: Already enabled but still prompted? macOS may have a record from an older version. Select LifeNarrator in the list, click “−” to remove it, then “+” to add it again. Or run this command in Terminal: tccutil reset ScreenCapture dev.lifenarrator.app
ocr.title: OCR languages
ocr.unavailable: Install Simplified Chinese or English (United States) OCR in Windows Settings.
appearance.pending: Appearance settings will be available with the bubble update.
